title: Oracle shadow action
statement: Given $n\geq 0$, an index $i<n$, an action of an $n$-work-tape machine over Boolean symbols with state set $S$, a Boolean $b$, and an optional Boolean marker, define an action for a machine with $n+1$ work tapes and state set $S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. It preserves the input-head movement, output, and successor-state presence; appends a work-tape instruction that writes nothing and moves in the same direction as tape $i$; and, for a successor state $q$, sets its Boolean component to true exactly when the marker is true and tape $i$'s movement is not left, and otherwise to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $n$ work tapes
$a$ is an action over Boolean symbols and state set $S$
the marker is an optional Boolean
